_comment: Copy to config/kb-map.json and fill in your own values.
kb-map.json is gitignored on purpose: it names real tenants, real
hosts and real local paths, and this repo is meant to have a shared remote.
Each KB needs a pat_env naming an environment variable in .env —
never put the token itself in this file.

example_kb.purpose: One sentence the router matches task intent against. Be specific: this text is the routing signal.

local_kb.purpose: A second KB, e.g. a local KB stack for notes that must not leave the laptop.
